If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 5. Commercial Eligibility Experience Criteria: Regarding financial capabili ty and experience, participating firms must have following documents: Pre-qualification: The bidder must have successfully executed/completed at least one single order of 80% of the Estimated Bid Value (i.e. Rs. 27,5 7,996.00) or 02 orders each of 50%of the Estimated Bid Value (i.e. Rs. 1 7,23,748.00) or 3 orders each of 40% of the Estimated Bid Value (i.e. Rs . 13,78,998.00) for Manpower Deployment in last three years(i.e. the cur rent financial year and the last three financial year) to any Central/State Go vt. Organization/PSU/Public listed Company. Copies of contracts/work or ders and documentary evidence of successful execution/completion in s upport of Past Experience along with names, address and contract details of clients shall be uploaded with the bid for verification by the bu yer. The Minimum Average Annual Financial Turnover : The bidder during st the last 03 years, ending on 31 March of the previous financial year sh

ould be at least 30% of the estimated cost. Hence, as per applicability o n GeM, it will be 11 Lakh. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Cha rtered Accountant/ Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for t he relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of co nstitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the averag e turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of c onstitution shall be taken into account for this criterion. Availability of office of service provider: An office of the service provid er must be located in the district of Kanpur Nagar/ Kanpur Dehat (Rama bai Nagar) / Unnao. For proof of address, documents in the name of firm or owner of the firm with address should be one of the following only: i. Certificate of Incorporation issued by Government of India, ii. GSTIN registration certificate with address iii. EPFO or ESIC registration certificate with address iv. Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM)/UDYAM registration certificate wit h address, v. The National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC) certificate wit h address, vi. Registration certificate of Shop or Commercial Establishment (Labour d epartment, Uttar Pradesh) with address. In case of non-submission of above mentioned documents by the participati ng firm at the time of technical bid, offer of the firm may be ignored and no further clarification may be asked. The buyer reserves a right to enhance the order quantity by fur ther 25% at the same price, terms and conditions. Payment terms and conditions:

i. Payment towards the services may include condition of payment such a s the cost of services quoted by the service provider shall cover all asp ects of service delivery and include all the components of the salary / w ages (minimum wages insurance, PF, ESI etc.) and taxes as applicable. ii. The payment shall also be made within 30 days, on monthly basis based on bill submitted by the service provider and accepted by the compete nt authority of the factory. iii. Non submission of the same may lead to delay/deduction i n payment. iv. All the penalties/fine/interest (if applicable) shall be settled before maki ng the payment, service provider shall not have any objection on the sa me. Payment shall be made through bank transfer only, in no circumsta nce cash/cheque payment shall be made. Execution of the contract: (as per clause no- 10.0 to 10.3 of attached sp ecification). Recovery/deduction on Deviation and Failures: (As per clause no- 13. 0 to 13.2 of attached specification). “Penalties/recoveries will be made as per term and conditions as given und er the heading of “Deductions” as mentioned in service level agreement and packages for man power out sourcing services-man-days based.” Repeated failure to provide satisfactory service will result in termination of the contract. tract. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken agai nst me as per the existing Rules. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the cu rrency of the contract at the contracted rates. Bidders are bound to acc ept the orders accordingly. Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). F DR should be made out or pledged in the name of A/C. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR docu ment in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee wi th GSTIN of Consignee only. The Seller shall not sub-contract the contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of the buyer. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together wit h the assignee/sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performanc e of the Contract and the seller’s obligations there under.

The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability oth erwise becomes apparent. The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or de fective Material(s) promptly.
